en.quote: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
en.riddle: Why do ye look one upon another?
en.speaker: Jacob

he.quote: וַיַּרְא יַעֲקֹב כִּי יֶשׁ־שֶׁבֶר בְּמִצְרָיִם וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לְבָנָיו לָמָּה תִּתְרָאֽוּ
he.speaker: יַעֲקֹב
